label: Motion, virtual actuality and capacity variants
summary:
17ec77f3-3943-5d12-b94a-e93a3e26fc45 (Variant): 8653b123 pairs virtual actuality exclusion with the virtual mover premise. Formal-only exclusion does not block an agent's virtual actuality and same-respect subject potency unless that virtual act implies formal actuality there. Retain the matched IN-ACT_2 branch.

4dd1d52a-574c-5d32-a8cd-d2a24d3f20fa (Variant): e417a889 treats potency as bare capability, so the exclusion forbids an existing exercise and retained capability together. STMT-SOME-CAPACITY-EXERCISED supplies the exact conditional failure case. Capacity under privation is the weaker relevant non-simultaneity on the adopted reading, changing the meaning of potency. Retain the POTENCY_3 comparison.

d4a26175-a984-5c19-85f1-b6aadbf095fe (Variant): 8653b123 requires virtual actuality of each mover in the same respect. Inclusive actuality provides too little for this branch since it permits a formally actual mover without virtual actuality. The inclusive branch has its own stronger exclusion. Retain the matched IN-ACT_2 branch.

d9daeb1e-1749-5473-9fae-04184dd5e40c (Variant): 4edc6de2 pairs inclusive actuality in movers with inclusive exclusion. be63edb7 projects the weaker formal exclusion; the formal exclusion alone cannot rule out virtual-only mover actuality alongside subject potency. Existing mixed-reading controls mark the failure. Retain the IN-ACT_3 branch with its stronger exclusion.

f590a5d5-d592-5734-bffd-0936ec276c4b (Variant): b44126c7 uses the IN-ACT_1 mover claim next to formal non-simultaneity, and 329c975b projects inclusive mover actuality from it. Inclusive actuality suffices in its own branch with inclusive non-simultaneity; it does not replace the formal mover claim in the frozen consumer. Retain the formal-only comparison.
